description: This file defines the SugarCacheMemcache class, which implements caching functionality using Memcache for the SugarCache system within SuiteCRM. It extends the abstract cache class, manages Memcache connections, and provides methods for cache operations such as set, get, clear, and reset.

classes.name: SugarCacheMemcache
classes.description: Implements cache storage using Memcache, extending the SugarCacheAbstract class in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Checks whether Memcache backend should be used based on extension availability and configuration.

methods.name: _getMemcacheObject
methods.description: Initializes and returns the Memcache object, configuring host, port, and compression settings.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in Memcache.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Retrieves a value from Memcache by key.
